Items.Name: Nutrition Room
Items.Description:
An integrated Nutrient Processor module, able to refine gathered ingredients into edible food products. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

User is advised that consumption of generated products is entirely at their own risk.

Items.Name: Appearance Modifier Room
Items.Description:
Integrated equipment allowing the user to adjust their personal appearance settings. This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

The module applies advanced holographic techniques to recalibrate the light around the user, allowing them to adopt whatever appearance they desire. Visual data must be properly formatted before use.

Items.Name: Stellar Extractor Room
Items.Description:
Gathers resources directly from the interstellar medium, via a complex system of suction intakes and condensing tubes. The gathered substance varies with the local star classification.

This module is placed as an entire room and comes with its functional units pre-installed.

A glutinous fleshy lump, harvested from a deep-space biohazard. Ingestion is not recommended.

This has been processed at a deep-space outpost, and can be sold on the open market.

Items.Name: Prismatic Core
Items.Description:
A constructable replica of Specialist Polo's Prismatic Core device, assembled from fragments and ichor to counteract the Hive of Glass.

All aspects of the Traveller soul are represented, forged around a Weaver heart.

Items.Name: Exocraft Terminal
Items.Description: A research station tailored to the needs of Technicians, and equipped with bespoke vehicular design software.

Items.Name: Oogc Banner
Items.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair to represent the OOGC Interstellar Alliance. We observe the world; we create the world.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Items.Name: Royal Space Society Banner
Items.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair to represent the Royal Space Society: a collaborative exploration community and refuge for Spanish-speaking Travellers.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Items.Name: Astronaut Figurine
Items.Description:
A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned from a long-forgotten curio.

Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

Items.Name: Salvage Claim
Items.Description:
A map to a location in deep space. A large wreck has been marked, rich with salvagable materials.

Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your navigation systems.

New maps can be gained by exchanging deep-space resources with an Outpost Quartermaster.

Items.Name: Habitable Asteroid Chart
Items.Description:
A map to a location in deep space. A large, habitable asteroid has been marked.

Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your navigation systems.

New maps can be gained by exchanging deep-space resources with an Outpost Quartermaster.

Items.Name: Our Journey Continues Banner
Items.Description:
Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the expedition Our Journey Continues, and the pilgrimage through past iterations of No Man's Sky.

Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

Items.Name: Diplo Egg
Items.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A long-necked diplodocus embryo is inside.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be gigantic and prehistoric.

Items.Name: Starbound V0.27
Items.Description:
An exclusive vintage Multi-Tool.

Recovered from a forgotten archive, this Multi-Tool evokes memories of a bygone era.

Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Items.Name: Title: 'time Traveller'
Items.Description:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the expedition Our Journey Continues, and the pilgrimage through past iterations of No Man's Sky.

Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Items.Name: Void Egg
Items.Description:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.

A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.

Items.Name: Companion Egg
Items.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

A playful being wriggles and fidgets inside. The creature dreams of soaring aloft, with a Traveller companion to carry on planetary adventures.

Items.Name: Atlas Firework Pack
Items.Description:
A three-variety pack of luxury fireworks. These stunning pyrotechnics render the likeness of an Atlas Interface, in bursts of indium, gold and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky.

Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

Items.Name: X. Spellristreus Egg
Items.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

The creature inside flexes its hefty torso.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential for a dutiful disposition; a faithful and hard-working companion.

Items.Name: N. Heydroadrus Egg
Items.Description:
A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch!

Large ears flap against the membrane of the egg, curiously listening to the world outside.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential for a loyal and affectionate companion.

Items.Name: Comet Dust
Items.Description:
An incredibly fine powder derived from the blasted remains of comet fragments. No evidence of its original crystalline matrix remains.

Comet fragments are located within deep-space asteroid belts

Items.Name: Contaminated Metal
Items.Description:
Torn fragments of old industrial components. Years of decay have left it pocked by exotic oxides and faintly irradiated. This material requires deep processing before it can be recycled into new components.

Salvaged from the creaking wreck of an abandoned space hulk.

Items.Name: Gelatinous Fibres
Items.Description:
Though apparently inorganic, the molecular makeup of these fibres has been drastically changed by exposure to both cosmic radiation and novel viral proteins.

Harvested from a deep-space biohazard site.

Items.Name: Golden Rasamama S36
Items.Description:
An exclusive golden edition of the classic Rasamama S36, commemorating completion of the expedition Our Journey Continues, and the pilgrimage through past iterations of No Man's Sky.

This highly-manoeuvrable spacecraft is constructed from a durable and precious alloy, and coated in a tough layer of fibrous insulation to endure many lifetimes' worth of rigorous space exploration.

Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

Items.Name: Vintage Interceptor

(QUICK_MENU).

Items.Description:
A extremely powerful upgrade for the Upgrade. Use [E] to begin upgrade installation process.

The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.

ChangedItems.Name: Elixir of Glass
ChangedItems.Description:
A slight membrane has begun to form over this viscous purple liquid. Beneath its glassy surface it swirls slowly, forming syrupy currents of its own accord.

The elixir will maintain your local boundary integrity and prevent the intrusion of the horrors beyond.

Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1 or inject it directly into the Anomaly Suppressor from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

ChangedItems.Name: Polyphonic Core
ChangedItems.Description:
An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units.

Use SCAN to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal any nearby Autophage entities.

In addition, this device can be used to locate Autophage gatherings. Use Locate Autophage Camp (FE_SELECT) to pinpoint a planetary gathering of Autophage.
